instructions: Fix the 14 recorded regressions in RUN-358-001-V001 from the first authored Runtime verification command. Reconstruct precise failing call paths and causes using the original Runtime-owned local verification evidence, and change production logic where it wrongly rejects lawful records. Do not assume 14 independent defects or turn tests green by weakening their asserted lifecycle/safety contracts.

Disambiguate exact Runtime private FAILURE originals, legacy redacted public metadata, authenticated AIOS_PUBLIC_FAILURE_V1/V2 projections, and genuinely incomplete historical observations. A private original may lawfully retain private captured diagnostics, while public projections must never contain raw/captured output, secret text, private paths, forged digest or source identity. Keep the original private source bytes unchanged and source-bound.

Repair the minimal failure_document/public_failure versus _validated_private_public_view and _matches_public_document/_matches_canonical_failure interactions that currently reject historical lawful correction predecessors and make Unified State return BLOCKED/NONE rather than legitimate WAIT, EXECUTE_REPAIR, AUTHOR_REMEDIATION or integration state. Preserve exact RUN/subject/TASK/evidence identities, canonical order, immutable correction lineage and role-aware validation; historical incomplete observations do not create fingerprints or PASS proof.

Exercise targeted positive and adversarial regression fixtures: the 14 failed node IDs where applicable, native-exit null and typed cause safety, lawful historical V1/V2/private plus incomplete observations, digest/subject/cross-RUN substitutions, secret-bearing public records, forged correction predecessor, inconsistent source bindings and malformed evidence. Retain existing expected non-PASS behavior for hostile cases; do not authorize auto-correction, retry/failover, publisher/reviewer or new lifecycle authority.

Keep every source and test change within the four listed TASK-358 scope.modify files; preserve the other 16 committed candidate changes and AC1–AC8 intent. If an actual root cause requires more scope or a new authority, stop and surface the blocker for separate Human/Brain authorization rather than modifying out of scope.

Return a clean committed correction candidate with accurate structural claims and unresolved items. Runtime alone owns canonical minimum-sufficient-v1 verification of all five exact TASK-358 required commands; do not run a full suite or substitute Executor test results for Runtime evidence, and do not fabricate REVIEW PASS or publish.

acceptance.condition: Lawful Runtime private FAILURE records with native exit code integer or null yield deterministic typed public diagnostics preserving RUN, TASK, phase, candidate and source identity while private original bytes remain unchanged.

Public/private FAILURE readers correctly distinguish legitimate historical formats and bounded incomplete historical observations from forged, inconsistent, substituted or secret-bearing records, without manufacturing detail, fingerprints or comparable PASS evidence.

Safe, bounded cause projection preserves actionable recognized native and verification failure categories, exact admissible command identity, and truthful availability, partial/truncation and withheld statuses without disclosing unrestricted native output.

Runtime terminal handling for dirty or non-publishable candidates can produce bound FAILURE artifacts and attention without publishing uncommitted source, or exposes an exact typed transport blocker if that transport is invalid.
Existing BP-2 pre-AIOS operational paths expose bounded typed causes with run_created=false and do not invent RUN, FAILURE or correction identity.

Existing attention, Unified State, fresh Brain Sync and provider/work-context consumers expose source-bound useful safe failure context, relevant candidate state and evidence identities without requiring raw-log hand copy.

An authorized admitted Executor can read relevant original private Runtime diagnostics locally only for its exact RUN and subject through existing workspace authority, rejecting cross-RUN, forged locator or mismatched digest.

Bounded regression fixtures exercise normal and hostile failure projection, timeout/null exit, dirty candidate, BP-2, attention, Brain context, authorized local private access, safe quoted pytest selectors and malicious commands, keeping unavailable source and integrity failures distinguishable from PASS.

assumptions: This is a new independent TASK revision 1 against canonical published main current at AUTHOR_TASK admission. Runtime must recheck expected-main CAS, identity, exact scope and source clean admission. No previous candidate, patch, bundle, staged RESULT, private worktree or failed RUN becomes implementation base, canonical proof or correction authorization.

Existing Runtime FAILURE and evidence remain engineering truth; BP-2 handles pre-AIOS operational failure; existing attention/Brain Sync/provider channels may expose safe diagnostic facts, but never raw private capture.
Existing terminal lineage, including legitimately incomplete historical V2 observations, remains immutable and non-PASS unless originally proven.
This TASK is independent of any separate execution-budget change and does not require a particular native response timeout to establish its outcomes.

hard: Retain existing Runtime/Brain/Executor/Reviewer/Publisher boundaries and trustworthy SHA/subject/RUN/evidence/provenance binding across all readers.

Original Runtime-owned private diagnostics stay byte-exact and local; authorized same-RUN/same-subject Executor reading remains read-only and bounded, with exact locator and digest rejection for substitution.
Public and portable diagnoses contain only a closed allowlist of useful typed failure facts, bounded safe causes and explicit availability, incompleteness, truncation and withholding indicators.

Historical legitimate incomplete observations may be described as incomplete without fabricated detail/fingerprint, implicit V2 attribution, waiver or source identity mismatch. Irreducibly invalid records expose typed blockers.
Reuse existing BP-2, attention, Unified State, Brain Sync and provider work context; no second lifecycle state store, private capture distributor or autonomous correction recommendation authority.

Implement positive and hostile synthetic fixtures, including unknown native exit, dirty candidate, safe quoted pytest -k, malicious quoting and secret strings. Do not use actual private machine logs as public test data.

task.goal: Deliver useful, bounded and trustworthy end-to-end FAILURE diagnostics through existing Runtime terminal records, BP-2 operational receipts, terminal attention, Unified State, fresh Brain Sync and authorized Executor-local private reading, with no new lifecycle authority or separate diagnostic service.
non_goals: No native Executor response-budget or watchdog-policy changes.
No new database, general diagnostic store, semantic router, planner, correction selector, Reviewer or Publisher.
No automatic retry/failover, lifecycle advancement, evidence substitution or new private-log upload surface.
No global declassification of sensitive native streams, credentials, secrets or host-local paths.
No retroactive alteration of historical FAILURE/EVIDENCE or conversion of partial observations into PASS.
No workflow-created RUN for pre-AIOS failure and no authority from a GitHub dispatch receipt alone.
task.problem: The published failure diagnostic path can reject otherwise lawful execution FAILURE projection and may mask useful safe causes, leaving Humans to manually extract private logs. A normal dirty candidate, native timeout with unknown exit code, lawful quoted pytest selector and legitimately incomplete historical observation need correct bounded diagnostics, exact identity binding and safe transport. The implementation must be established from published canonical source and independently verifiable synthetic cases, not unreviewed past candidates.
